title: Read-back and unaddressable failures carry a fixed kind code the chain diagnostics count; the chain plans without the kit index
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Each read-back difference and left-out item gets its kind code.
The diagnostics count each group's failures by kind, never by their words.
The chain's planner run has no kit index in its first message.

tests: a read-back difference is empty, cut short, the ordered words with markup, or other
an item the write step left out is sorted by why it had nothing to write to
the diagnostics count each group by its kinds, never its words
the chain's planner run reads the kit by tool from its contents and thinks its first draft at the run's effort
